## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: The extension manifest declares cookies and host permissions for...

The system SHALL ensure that the extension manifest declares cookies and host permissions for substack.com and x.com only.

#### Scenario: The extension manifest declares cookies and host permissions for...

WHEN `add-sync-session-button-to-the-chrome-extension` is implemented
THEN The extension manifest declares cookies and host permissions for substack.com and x.com only.

### Requirement: Clicking Sync session posts the three cookies to the endpoint with the admin...

The system SHALL ensure that clicking Sync session posts the three cookies to the endpoint with the admin key header and shows success or the endpoint error without displaying cookie values.

#### Scenario: Clicking Sync session posts the three cookies to the endpoint with the admin...

WHEN `add-sync-session-button-to-the-chrome-extension` is implemented
THEN Clicking Sync session posts the three cookies to the endpoint with the admin key header and shows success or the endpoint error without displaying cookie values.

### Requirement: The extension README documents the tailnet API URL and the sync action

The system SHALL ensure that the extension README documents the tailnet API URL and the sync action.

#### Scenario: The extension README documents the tailnet API URL and the sync action

WHEN `add-sync-session-button-to-the-chrome-extension` is implemented
THEN The extension README documents the tailnet API URL and the sync action.
